# Passport Room

> Passport Room is a free online passport and visa photo maker. Every image
> operation runs inside the visitor's web browser, so photos are never
> uploaded to a server. No account, no watermark, no export limit.

Site: https://passport-room.com
Contact: support@passport-room.com
Operator: Passport Room, an independent team based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
Cost: free. Signup: not required. Watermark: none.

## What it does

A user opens a portrait photo, picks a country's ID photo standard, and the app
removes the background, frames the subject at the required head height, lets the
user adjust the image, and exports a print-ready JPEG or PNG or a tiled print
sheet. Processing happens on the user's own device.

## Privacy summary

Photos are processed locally in the browser and are never transmitted to
Passport Room or to any third party. The app has no photo upload endpoint. The only
network requests are one-time downloads of AI model files from huggingface.co,
the onnxruntime-web runtime and three.js from cdn.jsdelivr.net, and web fonts
from Google Fonts; none of these requests contain image data. Profile settings
and optional photo history are stored in the browser's localStorage and
IndexedDB on the user's device only.

## Features

- AI background removal: a MODNet segmentation model runs in the browser via
  onnxruntime-web (WebGPU, with a WebAssembly fallback). The photo is never
  uploaded; only the model file is downloaded, once, then cached on the device.
- Passport and visa photo sizing: renders at exact millimetre dimensions, 300
  DPI and the required head-height ratio. Presets: United States 2x2 in, United
  Kingdom 35x45 mm, Schengen/EU visa 35x45 mm, India 35x45 mm and 2x2 in OCI,
  Canada 50x70 mm, Australia 35x45 mm, China visa 33x48 mm, Bangladesh 45x55 mm
  and 38x48 mm. Custom sizes can be entered manually.
- Print-sheet composition: tiles multiple copies of the finished photo at true
  scale onto one printable sheet with cutting guides, for home printers and
  photo kiosks.
- Outfit try-on editor: overlays a formal garment image (five bundled options or
  a user-supplied PNG) onto the photo, positioned by dragging, resizing and
  rotating on a browser canvas. It is a manual overlay, not a generated body.
- AI face enhance: a GPEN-BFR-256 face-restoration model sharpens and cleans a
  soft face while keeping the person recognisable, with Natural and Strong
  presets. It runs in the browser through onnxruntime-web.
- In-browser photo editor: brightness, contrast, saturation, exposure, shadows,
  highlights, sharpness, clarity and noise, plus compliant background colours
  (white, off-white, light blue, grey, or custom). All adjustments are local.
- Local account and photo history: display name, avatar, preferences and
  optional recent photos are stored in the browser's localStorage and IndexedDB
  on that device only. There is no server account, no password and no sync.
- Export: JPEG or PNG at full preset resolution and 300 DPI, no watermark, no
  limit.

## Limitations

Matching a published size specification does not guarantee that a passport
office, embassy or licensing authority will accept a photo. Those bodies also
judge lighting, expression, eyewear, head coverings and how recent the photo is.
Passport Room is independent and is not affiliated with any government or passport
agency.
